7839.title: Constraint-specific handling of failed memory writes
7839.rootCauseOneLine: The add transaction translates every SQLite uniqueness failure, including history-version collisions, into an active-name conflict.

prReviews.verdict: Static review only; closed and unmerged
prReviews.topFinding: The active-name lookup appears to avoid the reported misclassification; no linked patch code was executed.

7839.proposedFix: Target only the active scope/name conflict in the memory INSERT and allow unrelated transaction errors to propagate unchanged.
7839.caveats: Real SQLite fault injection confirms the error-classification bug, not a spontaneous production history collision. Reproduction code and results are inline because the report repository forbids standalone artifacts.
